status: PROPOSED - freeze on independent review; no truth was consulted in any choice below
rationale: scVelo 0.3.4 defines velocity as Mu - gamma*Ms (tools/velocity.py:79,167) from layers Ms/Mu (tools/velocity.py:37,39), where Ms = connectivities . spliced with NO log (preprocessing/moments.py:89-95), and its own velocity-vs-state tooling uses xkey='Ms' (tools/velocity_graph.py:49). The only coherent GeoBRIDGE pairing is therefore dMs with dvelocity.

input_requirements.fail_closed: a dataset lacking these is classified SENSITIVITY-ONLY / GEOMETRY-ONLY / INCOMPATIBLE and EXCLUDED from primary analysis; no layer substitution is permitted

filter_and_normalize.note: scVelo 0.3.4 filter_and_normalize does ONLY filter_genes + normalize_per_cell (preprocessing/utils.py:389-405): NO HVG selection and NO log1p, and scv.pp.filter_genes_dispersion / scv.pp.log1p do not exist in this version. Each step is therefore called explicitly: scv.pp.filter_genes(min_shared_counts, retain_genes=FULL TF catalogue) -> scv.pp.normalize_per_cell (normalises X, spliced, unspliced) -> sc.pp.highly_variable_genes(n_top_genes, flavor='seurat') on a LOG VIEW only -> subset to HVG union TF catalogue -> sc.pp.log1p(.X only). spliced/unspliced stay on the normalised linear scale because moments() builds Ms/Mu from them.

tf_retention.rule: force-retain the ENTIRE species TF catalogue that survives min_shared_counts, never a truth-derived or perturbation-derived subset

moments.note: defaults to the neighbors graph above

geobridge_representation.prohibited: any hybrid such as dX from log-normalised .X with dV in native Ms velocity units

sensitivity_representation.name: log_coherent
sensitivity_representation.rule: if retained, applied to EVERY compatible dataset; never mixed per dataset
sensitivity_representation.known_limitation: dlog1p(Ms) equals (Ms_j-Ms_i)/(1+Ms_i) only to first order, so dX and its chain-rule dV are mutually consistent only for small changes; the native arm has no such approximation

projector_metric.decided_by: coordinate battery + cross-subsample reproducibility (gb_coordinate.py). NEVER by truth.

pair_construction.note: roots are reported separately and never pooled or selected between

k_selection.status: OPEN - one rule for every dataset, chosen on methodological properties
candidates: blocked BCV (cell-disjoint rows x gene columns)
hard_rules: polarity-blind: activation and repression share one k
effective sample size is n_cells, never n_pairs, because D_X = B.X

gene_fold_cross_fitting.measured_risk: overlap(P_k^(-F), P_k^full) on PANC full pair count falls 0.98 (k<=3) -> 0.95 (k=8) -> 0.87 (k=31) -> 0.79 (k=50); source+target DOUBLE exclusion is therefore NOT production-safe at deployment depth

dataset_overrides.policy: none permitted unless classified as biological-design metadata (e.g. species TF catalogue). Performance-motivated overrides are forbidden and must be listed here if ever granted.

verified_against.path: miniconda3/envs/jupyter_env/.../scvelo (the copy that RUNS under PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1)
verified_against.note: semantics cross-checked in BOTH the conda copy and the ~/.local AFS copy; moments.py:89,94, velocity.py:37,39,79,167 and velocity_graph.py:49 are identical in both
